name: Darren Beattie
current_role: Senior official, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs, U.S. Department of State; named senior adviser for Brazil policy in 2026
summary: Darren Beattie, a former Trump speechwriter fired in 2018 after it emerged he had spoken at a conference attended by white nationalists, returned in 2025 as a senior State Department official over educational and cultural affairs. In July 2025 the U.S. Institute of Peace board made him its acting president while he kept his State post, drawing bipartisan criticism; in early 2026 he was named senior adviser for Brazil policy.
